summary: Poach competitors' unhappy customers instead of educating strangers. — The instructional secret is that your cheapest customer acquisition channel is your competitor's one-star reviews — a side hustle can skip the expensive job of creating demand and just intercept demand that already exists.

title: Win By Doing Less
summary: Keep a not-to-build list to protect the one profitable thing. — Your side hustle isn't dying from lack of ideas — it's dying because every extra feature you build quietly starves the one thing customers actually pay for.

title: LLMs still produce bugs, but those bugs are different than what they used to be. It’s less off-by-ones and more about system design, ui usab
summary: LLMs still produce bugs, but those bugs are different than what they used to be. It’s less off-by-ones and more about system design, ui usability, missing broader context. Some kinds of coding has been solved, but not all. While models continue to improve, adversarial code review has been an incredibly powerful tool to catch many of these kinds of bugs. It can be as simple as a one line prompt - “use a dynamic workflow to adversarial test every edge case in an iOS simulator”, or use Claude’s built in /code-review (or /code-review low, /code-review medium, etc.)
